name: Huntarr-Sonarr
description:
DEPRECATED: Use Huntarr instead. 
        [br]
        Huntarr (Sonarr Edition) continually searches your Sonarr library for shows with missing episodes and episodes that need quality upgrades. It automatically triggers searches for both missing episodes and episodes below your quality cutoff. It's designed to run continuously while being gentle on your indexers, helping you gradually complete your TV show collection with the best available quality.
requires: Requires a separate Sonarr v5 instance.

variables.name: Enable Web UI
variables.description: Enable the web UI for Huntarr

variables.name: Sonarr - API Key
variables.description: API key for your Sonarr instance

variables.name: Sonarr - Monitored Only
variables.description: Only process monitored shows and episodes

variables.name: Sonarr - Skip Metadata Refresh
variables.description: Skip refreshing metadata for series before searching.

variables.name: Huntarr - Missing Shows Per Cycle
variables.description: Maximum missing shows to process per cycle. Set to 0 to disable.

variables.name: Huntarr - Upgrade Episodes Per Cycle
variables.description: Maximum upgrade episodes to process per cycle. Set to 0 to disable.

variables.name: Huntarr - Use Random Selection for Missing
variables.description: Use random selection for processing missing shows if enabled, or sequential if disabled.

variables.name: Huntarr - Use Random Selection for Upgrade
variables.description: Use random selection for processing upgrade episodes if enabled, or sequential if disabled.

variables.name: Sonarr - API Timeout
variables.description: Timeout for API requests in seconds.

variables.name: Huntarr - Sleep Duration
variables.description: Duration, in seconds, to wait between cycles.

variables.name: Huntarr - Reset Interval
variables.description: Interval, in hours, after which to reset the processed state files. Set to 0 to disable.

variables.name: Huntarr - Minimum Queue Size
variables.description: Minimum number of items in the download queue before starting a hunt. Set to -1 to disable.

variables.name: Debug Mode
variables.description: Enable debug mode for detailed logging.

variables.name: Command Status - Wait Time
variables.description: Delay in seconds between checking for command status

variables.name: Command Status - Max Attempts
variables.description: Maximum number of attempts to check for command status
